title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta1

## Canonical architecture beta 1

This is the first beta of the paired Navimower 0.5 / Map Card 0.4 architecture migration. It introduces a new **Canonical Mower State** in shadow mode while keeping the proven 0.4 runtime authoritative.

The matching frontend prerelease is **Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta1**.

## What is new

- Adds a pure canonical state reducer with explicit source/freshness metadata.
- Adds one PositionResolver shadow decision: fresh official MQTT wins; stale/sparse MQTT falls back to private-cloud position.
- Projects the existing ZoneLedger candidate into a CycleEngine-shaped per-zone model and records VendorTrailStore geometry ownership beside it.
- Projects one TaskState candidate from the ZoneLedger task result.
- Adds cached-only canonical_v2 diagnostics with old-vs-new parity checks.
- Adds replay-style regressions for a **sparse-MQTT H1** and a normal dense-MQTT mower.
- Canonical diagnostics intentionally contain no exact mower X/Y coordinates.

## Why the H1 case matters

Some first-generation H-series units can keep the Navimow app working while Smart Home MQTT location updates are extremely sparse. The new model treats position transport and current-cycle vendor geometry as independent concerns: stale MQTT may reduce live marker cadence, but it must not invalidate vendor coverage or vendor mowing geometry.

## Safety of this beta

**No public entity, service, Schedule, Gate, History or Map Card state is moved to the new model in beta1.** The existing runtime remains the public owner. Canonical v2 is calculated beside it only for diagnostics and replay/parity testing.

The temporary shadow hook is intentionally not a permanent compatibility layer. Beta2 is the planned authority cutover after field parity is reviewed.

## Upgrade pairing

For this new beta line, test the matching pair:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta1
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta1

Old stable users may remain on their existing matching versions.
